en.Google Cloud Translate API-Key (ggf. der: Google Cloud Translate API key (may be the same one as your real Simple Locale instance)
en.Zielsprache (Google-Sprachcode, z.B. \"e: Target language (Google language code, e.g. "en", "fr", "es" - any code works, it just has to differ from the test sentence's source language)
en.Übersetzt den Testsatz \"Hallo Welt\" (D: Translates the test sentence "Hallo Welt" (German) into the target language configured above and shows the result here - lets you check the API key right in this form without writing any code. The actual test function for your own module development is IPSSLT_TranslateText(), see the README.
